universe.title: MechWarrior / BattleTech Universe
universe.description: The BattleTech universe is set in a future where humanity has expanded across the stars via the K-F Drive. The Inner Sphere is dominated by giant humanoid war machines called BattleMechs, piloted by elite warriors known as MechWarriors. Five Great Houses rule the Successor States, while the Clans threaten from beyond known space.
source_material: BattleTech tabletop game (FASA, Catalyst Game Labs)

inner_sphere.description: The Inner Sphere is the region of space humanity colonized after achieving faster-than-light travel via the K-F Drive. It consists of a spiral arm of star systems stretching from the central star Terra (Earth) outward in a rough spiral pattern.

star_league.description: The Star League was a multinational administrative and peacekeeping treaty. During this era, mankind achieved technological marvels. The Star League Defense Force (SLDF), led by General Aleksandr Kerensky, was the military arm. After the collapse in 2781, Kerensky led Operation Exodus in 2784, taking the bulk of the SLDF beyond known space.
star_league.significance: Golden age of the Inner Sphere. Kerensky's Exodus led to the formation of the Clans.

succession_wars.description: Following the fall of the Star League, the five Great Houses fought four devastating wars. Nearly 300 years of conflict caused unimaginable devastation: hundreds of billions died, hundreds of worlds were rendered lifeless, and technological progress was pushed back centuries.

wars.name: Fourth Succession War
wars.outcome: Lyran Commonwealth and Federated Suns united to form the Federated Commonwealth

clan_invasion.description: The Clans, descendants of the SLDF, returned to the Inner Sphere with the goal of conquering it. The invasion was ultimately repelled through a combination of Inner Sphere resistance and Clan internal conflicts.
clan_invasion.significance: Forced the Great Houses to cooperate, leading to the formation of the Star League Addendum

davion.name: House Davion
davion.description: Known for their military prowess and chivalric traditions, the Davions are considered the most martial of the Great Houses. The Federated Suns excels in combined arms tactics and produces some of the finest MechWarriors in the Inner Sphere.
davion.motto: The Sun Rises on the Federated Commonwealth

steiner.name: House Steiner
steiner.description: The Lyran Commonwealth is the Inner Sphere's greatest economic power, with advanced technology and a strong industrial base. Known for Germanic cultural influences and the Lyran Combat Group (LCG) doctrine.

kurita.name: House Kurita
kurita.description: The Draconis Combine embraces 'the way of the warrior' with strong Japanese cultural influence. Personal honor and self-reliance bordering on xenophobia are encouraged. Known for aggressive expansionism and the Bushido code.

marik.name: House Marik
marik.description: The Free Worlds League is characterized by its libertarian political culture, where individual worlds enjoy significant autonomy. Known for political intrigue and internal instability ('Marik Madness').

liao.name: House Liao
liao.description: The Capellan Confederation is characterized by Chinese cultural influences, authoritarian government, and emphasis on espionage and subterfuge. Known for large population and extensive use of infantry and vehicles alongside BattleMechs.

clans.description: The Clans are descendants of the Star League Defense Force that followed General Kerensky in Operation Exodus. After centuries in the Deep Periphery, they developed unique technologies and a rigid caste-based society. They returned to the Inner Sphere with the goal of conquering it.

combat_culture.description: Clan combat is governed by strict codes of honor and tradition.
practices: Trial of Possession - conquer territory through combat
Trial of Annihilation - fight to the death
Trial of Grievance - personal duel to settle disputes
Trial of Absolution - prove innocence through combat
Ghastille - fair combat with matched forces

comstar.name: ComStar
comstar.description: The neutral interstellar communications organization that controls Terra and maintains the Star Drive Network. ComStar evolved from the Communications and Electronics Corporation into a powerful religious and political organization.
roles: Guards the secrets of the K-F Drive
comstar.influence: ComStar's control of the Star Drive Network gives it de facto control over interstellar travel and communication.

battletech.description: BattleMechs are giant humanoid war machines, typically 4 to 10 meters tall and weighing 20 to 100 tons. They are the cornerstone of Inner Sphere military power.

light.description: Limited armor and weapon capacity but superior mobility. Used as scouts and anti-personnel units.

medium.description: The workhorses of most armies. Best combination of speed, armor, and payload.

heavy.description: Frontline combat with substantial firepower and durability. Can mount heavy weapons.

assault.description: Maximum firepower and armor at the cost of speed. Used as spearheads and command units.

energy.description: Fire beams of concentrated energy. No ammunition needed but generate significant heat.

ballistic.description: Fire physical projectiles. Require ammunition but generate minimal heat.

missile.description: Fire guided projectiles. Require ammunition and generate moderate heat.

key_locations.significance: Control of Terra gives control of the Star Drive Network
